description: The pie chart illustrates the comparison between the time cost before and after the implementation of efficient deployment methods. It shows two categories: "Efficient deployment" and "Reduction." The "Efficient deployment" category is represented by a blue slice, accounting for 30.5% of the total time cost, which is 30.5 seconds. The "Reduction" category is represented by an orange slice, making up 69.5% of the total time cost, which is 62 seconds. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices, indicating the proportion of each category. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way, and there is no legend present. The segments are ordered by size, with the "Reduction" category being the larger of the two.
caption_used: Efficient deployment methods significantly reduce the time cost, with the average total time cost before efficient deployment being 92.5s (30.5s + 62s). This represents a reduction of approximately 72.5% after efficient deployment, highlighting the substantial impact of optimization strategies.
